name: STOP no Coreto: Esquizofonia
description: Enjoy a free open-air concert in a historic garden as part of the "STOP no Coreto" summer series. This Saturday features the band Esquizofonia, promising a perfect weekend soundtrack.
longDescription:
"STOP no Coreto: Esquizofonia" is a free musical performance held outdoors as part of a recurring summer program. This particular event on August 8, 2026, features the band Esquizofonia, known for their distinct sound. The "STOP no Coreto" series aims to bring live music to public spaces, offering cultural engagement to residents and visitors alike throughout the warmer months.

Attendees can expect an evening concert in the Jardim da Cordoaria, a historical garden setting. The atmosphere is typically relaxed, suitable for enjoying music in an open-air environment. The event is designed for a general audience, providing a backdrop for a summer Saturday evening in Porto. The duration of the performance is consistent with typical live music sets.

Admission is free, with no prior booking required; visitors are welcome to attend on a walk-in basis. The Jardim da Cordoaria is centrally located and accessible, approximately a 5-minute walk from the Aliados metro station or a short walk from various bus stops in the city center. The outdoor nature of the venue makes it generally accessible.
